entries.fbbe7f67dfad0d62: Its distinguishing feature is that it has developed in-house pile methods, such as the Nakabori method, TN-X method, ATT Column method, Gantetsu pairu method and CP-X method, and ground improvement methods, such as the Tenokoramu method, Tenokyubu method and Pure Pile method, and that it holds official backing such as patents, certification by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, and technical review certification. It also continues development to improve construction quality, including deploying construction management equipment across all methods.
